loiGiai: Ta có: $\displaystyle\int f(x)\text{d}x = \displaystyle\int \left( x^2 - \displaystyle\frac{2}{x^2} \right) \text{d}x = \displaystyle\int x^2\text{d}x - 2 \displaystyle\int \displaystyle\frac{1}{x^2}\text{d}x = \displaystyle\frac{x^3}{3} - 2 \cdot \displaystyle\frac{-1}{x} + C = \displaystyle\frac{x^3}{3} + \displaystyle\frac{2}{x} + C$.
